Quality isn't checked at the end. It's built into the process.

  1. SOURCE

    Agree specifications and grade with the supplier.

  2. INSPECT

    Sampling and visual inspection of each lot.

  3. TEST

    Moisture, purity and laboratory testing against spec.

  4. VERIFY

    Third-party inspection, documentation and traceability.

  5. SHIP

    Packing and dispatch coordinated end to end.
